shared_elements: surfaces covered with dense repeated relief motifs
justification: Both surfaces bear carved sign-like motifs in low relief, including circular/disc shapes, but A is a three-dimensional anthropomorphic figure with a head, wig-like mass and a belted body ornamented with discs and looping motifs, while B is a flat wall covered with dense horizontal rows of small script-like signs. The organisation is fundamentally different: a single sculpted body with symbols distributed over it versus register-like lines of repeated inscription, so the correspondence is only the generic fact of incised symbols on stone.
